The '''Darakin system''' was a [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] [[Star system/Legends|star system]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It shared its name with [[Darakin University]].<ref name="GG6">[[Galaxy Guide 6: Tramp Freighters (Second Edition)|''Galaxy Guide 6, Tramp Freighters'', Second Edition]]</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Darakin system was first mentioned in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', written by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square M-11.<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref>
